name: ITCONS E-Solutions Limited
summary: ITCONS E-Solutions Ltd. operates as a specialist in talent acquisition and recruitment. The firm provides strategic staffing solutions across a broad spectrum of industries, encompassing Information Technology, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Oil and Gas, Engineering, Logistics/Transportation, Light Industrial, Media, Finance/Accounting, Administrative Services/Clerical, and Marketing/Creative. Its clientele also includes State and Central Government organizations, as well as Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs). Established on May 15, 2007, the company maintains its head office in New Delhi, India.
